title: Kissed Tunisian Olives Skewers
description: A bitter, tender, date-night Tunisian dish featuring olives, air-fried to perfection with a dash of cumin, paprika, and lemon zest.
instructions: Remove stems from olives and slice them in half lengthwise.
Thread the sliced olives onto bamboo skewers, spacing them evenly.
In a small bowl, whisk together olive oil, minced garlic, cumin, paprika, lemon zest, salt, and pepper.
Brush the olive mixture over each skewer, ensuring the olives are coated.
Preheat the air fryer to 200°C (400°F) for 3 minutes.
Place the skewers in the air fryer basket in a single layer, avoiding overlap.
Air fry for 8 minutes, flipping halfway, until the olives are slightly caramelized.
Remove from the air fryer, sprinkle chopped parsley, and serve immediately.
